title: Sean McVay says NFL told him pass interference should not have been called on Josh Wallace

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Sean McVay says NFL told him pass interference should not have been called on Josh Wallace
sources.description: The call negated what appeared to be a game-sealing interception for the Rams and set up the Broncos' game-winning touchdown.
